items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: I don't think George played as good as Henry, but George is still a terrific trombone player.

ctx.x: take a parade. He wouldn't march his men in a parade. Oh,
by the way, you're not going to hurt George's feelings by answering this because... Who's George? I mean, George Brunas' feelings, but how did George compare with Henny?
I don't think any... I don't think George played as good as Henry, but George is still a terrific trombone player.
